title: Chromite Watchfire LCAC Landings Part 1
description: U.S. Marines with 3rd Light Armored Reconnaissance Battalion, 1st Marine Division, disembark from a Landing Craft Air Cushion in support of Exercise Chromite Watchfire at Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton, California, Feb. 16 2021. Chromite Watchfire is a training exercise that focuses on Navy and Marine Corps integration as well as combat readiness. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Frank Webb)
